---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Provide a specific use case or example of how this feature would be used.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how to implement this feature, please share them here.

## Related Adapters

Which adapters would this feature affect?
- [ ] Ticketing (Jira, etc.)
- [ ] Code Repository (GitHub, etc.)
- [ ] CI/CD (GitHub Actions, etc.)
- [ ] Observability (Azure AKS, etc.)
- [ ] LLM (Azure OpenAI, etc.)
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Blocking my use of Brad
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement
